insights.title: Key Insights - Asset Accumulation (Individual Indicators)
insights.item1: Household average assets grew 152% from 2.1 to 5.3 assets per household, with total value of R 45,680
insights.item2: Participant personal assets increased 250% from 1.2 to 4.2 assets, demonstrating strong wealth accumulation
insights.item3: Top household asset growth: Agricultural Equipment (+29%), Dwelling/Housing (+26%), Livestock (+23%)
insights.item4: Top participant asset growth: Savings/Investments (+46%), Business Equipment (+39%), Technology (+39%)

insights.title: Key Insights - Record-Keeping (Individual Indicators)
insights.item1: Personal record-keeping score increased 375% from 0.8 to 3.8 out of 4.0, showing strong adoption of financial discipline
insights.item2: Business record-keeping score increased 567% from 0.6 to 4.0 out of 4.0, reaching maximum score
insights.item3: 92% of participants now maintain regular records, up from 28% at baseline
insights.item4: Top adopted practices: Sales/Income Records (82%), Expense Tracking (78%), Customer Records (72%)

insights.title: Key Insights - Savings (Individual Indicators)
insights.item1: Household savings grew 655% from R 850 (baseline) to R 6,420 (12-month), demonstrating strong savings discipline.
insights.item2: Participant savings increased 1,198% from R 420 to R 5,450, showing remarkable wealth accumulation.
insights.item3: 94% of participants now save regularly (monthly or more frequently), up from 32% at baseline.
insights.item4: 64% use Stokvels, 58% use bank accounts, and 38% use mobile money - strong adoption of formal savings products.
